meta.note: Educational comparison, not a prediction and not an official evacuation plan. Fires are illustrative scenario outputs; people are synthetic households; minutes are model time, not a forecast. A share of runs is not a probability.
meta.encoding: streets[fire][severity].ember/front: one base-36 digit per street segment (network edge id order), the number of runs (of streets[fire][severity].runs) in which the modeled embers or fire front reached the segment's midpoint cell within the run
